---
title: "Verify a Release"
subtitle: "Retain evidence independently of pipeline success"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

There is no release to verify during scaffolding. This page defines the
evidence boundary that the future release implementation must satisfy.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Release Completion"}

The versioned release target must have completed, and the approving reviewer
must identify the exact release directory and expected resources.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Validate The Published Artifact"}

Future verification must:

- load the published artifact through its declared interchange format;
- validate every resource against its schema;
- confirm identifiers and prohibited fields are absent;
- compare published resources with their curated targets;
- record package versions, source provenance, checksums, and review approval;
- run the pipeline again and confirm that no target rebuilds.

Verification code belongs here only after the release contract is approved.

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Retain Reproducible Evidence"}

Store non-disclosive verification output with the release record. Never include
protected rows or values in the rendered Manual, scheduler logs, or version
control.

:::
